verdict.rationale: Poly documents a two-stage deletion model: `rm` moves files to an Archive, and permanently deleting from the Archive is an action reserved for the user (blocked for MCP agents). Mind memories are also user-editable. These give users some control over deletion, but nothing documents control over retention itself; version history appears to be kept indefinitely. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods or policies, control over how long version and conflict history is kept, account-level or full data deletion, documentation of deletion for indexed or derived AI data, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: rm archives files (reversible), and permanently deleting from the Archive is reserved for you
